description.value: NeNe Chicken is a Korean fried chicken restaurant on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, part of a small Canadian chain with locations across BC and Ontario. The restaurant offers indoor seating and online ordering through its own app and website. Touring cyclists passing through the West End will find it a convenient stop for a hearty Korean fried chicken meal in a busy urban neighbourhood.
